name: petlove
description: PetLove: app React Native (front-end) + API Node.js (back-end) + banco SQLite

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix app
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,APP -c magenta,cyan "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix app"
scripts.web: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run web --prefix app"
